title: Braised Beet Pilaf
description: A hearty, comforting pilaf dish with roasted beets and a hint of Ukrainian flair.
instructions: Peel and chop the beets into 1-inch cubes.
Toss beets with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast beets in the oven for 25-30 minutes, or until tender.
Heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Add roasted beets, thyme, salt, and pepper to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
